canonical_selected_raw_stream.comparison_scope: actual ordered selected values and multiplicity

source_manifest.coverage_claim: complete selected physical scan, conditional on the acquired stream; inspect gaps/quality

projection.initialization_basis: observed prefix only; absence of earlier gaps is not certified
projection.quote_domain: positive exact quarter-point prices, bid <= ask, positive sizes below uint32 undefined sentinel
projection.size_domain: 0 < eligible executed size < 2**32 - 1; invalid/snapshot records retained separately
projection.strategy_receipt: missing; choose a separate named event-plus-delay scenario
projection.venue_status: not supplied; a separately labeled market-state scenario or observed status evidence is required

unit.coverage_basis: separately observed acquired source; overlapping acquisitions are not concatenated
